title: Condition aware learning enables robust prediction of oligonucleotide melting behavior across diverse chemistries and assay conditions
abstract: arXiv:2609.05454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Oligonucleotide melting temperature is a fundamental determinant of nucleic acid hybridization and underpins the design of molecular diagnostics, polymerase chain reaction assays, and many other biotechnology applications. However, accurately predicting melting behavior remains difficult because it depends not only on sequence composition, but also on experimental conditions and chemical modifications commonly used in modern assay design. Existing thermodynamic models rely on fixed parameterizations that are often difficult to extend across diverse reaction environments and nucleotide chemistries. Here we show that a condition-aware nucleotide language model can accurately predict oligonucleotide melting behavior across diverse experimental conditions and both unmodified and chemically modified oligonucleotides. translated_title: 条件感知学习实现对不同化学修饰与检测条件下寡核苷酸熔解行为的稳健预测
translated_abstract: 寡核苷酸熔解温度是核酸杂交的基本决定因素，是分子诊断、聚合酶链式反应（PCR）检测以及众多其他生物技术应用设计的基础。然而，准确预测熔解行为仍然十分困难，因为它不仅取决于序列组成，还取决于现代检测设计中常用的实验条件和化学修饰。现有的热力学模型依赖于固定的参数化方法，往往难以推广至不同的反应环境和核苷酸化学体系。在本研究中，我们展示了一种条件感知的核苷酸语言模型，能够在多种实验条件下准确预测未修饰和化学修饰寡核苷酸的熔解行为。通过将上下文序列表示与描述反应环境的显式信息相结合，该框架……
tldr: 提出了一种条件感知的核苷酸语言模型，将上下文序列表示与反应环境信息相结合，能够在多种实验条件下准确预测未修饰和化学修饰寡核苷酸的熔解行为，克服了传统固定参数热力学模型难以推广的局限。
en_tdlr: A condition-aware nucleotide language model that combines contextual sequence representations with explicit reaction environment information enables accurate prediction of melting behavior for both unmodified and chemically modified oligonucleotides across diverse experimental conditions, overcoming the limitations of fixed thermodynamic parameterizations.
